title: Doing, Redoing, or Undoing Gender of Women Tech Founders in Germany
core_idea: Investigate how women founders in German tech startups perceive and actively construct visibility, and whether they position themselves to reproduce (doing), restructure (redoing), or eliminate (undoing) the masculinity–femininity dualism in that visibility.
tldr: The study asks what visibility women tech founders in Germany consider important and how they actively create gender-(in)dependent visibility—locating themselves within doing, redoing, or undoing gender—based on qualitative interviews.
